title: NYC/NJ Aquatic Vertebrate eDNA Project: Protocols I
author: Mark Stoeckle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p9gdr3w
materials: 7 3B. Check PCR yield 1. Run 5 µl each PCR tube on 2.5% agarose gel in 1X TBE with SyberSafe dye and DNA size markers. Expected product approximately 207 bp. We also usually get a band at about 100 bp including in negative control; this presumably is a primer dimer. In some runs there is a noticeable 200 bp band in negative controls. So far these have turned out to be human or domestic animal (pig, chicken, turkey, cow) amplicons. Human and domestic animal DNA are common contaminants in PCR reagents. Sample gel: 3C. Purify PCR products—two alternative methods Follow AMPure protocol (see below), resuspend in 40 µl Elution Buffer. OR An easier approach that works well so far is to simply dilute the PCR reaction mixes 1:20 in Elution Buffer (Qiagen). DNA purification with AMPure beads Summary: DNA purification, concentration using magnetic beads (this closely follows manufacturer’s protocol) Time: About 1-2 h, depending on number of samples. Equipment: AMPure beads in solution per manufacturer’s protocol MagnaRack Elution Buffer (Qiagen) or equivalent (10mM Tris, pH 8.3) 80% EtOH

steps.title: Prepare Work Area
steps.instruction: Set up the workspace on an open bench wearing gloves. Wipe down the work area and equipment with 10% bleach after use. Use separate sets of pipettors and reagents for pre- and post-PCR work. Use unfiltered pipette tips and discard them after each procedure, rinsing collection containers with 10% bleach.

steps.title: Isolate DNA from Filter
steps.instruction: Perform the following centrifugation and elution steps using 1.5 ml microfuge tubes or 2 ml collection tubes.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 1 min at 10,000g.
Transfer 625 µl of supernatant to a new 2 ml Collection Tube.
Shake Solution C4 before use, add 1 ml Solution C4 to the supernatant, and invert 20 times to mix.
Load 675 µl onto a Spin Filter and centrifuge at 10,000g for 1 min at room temp; discard flow through.
Repeat the loading and centrifugation of 675 µl increments until all supernatant is processed, discarding flow through each time.
Add 500 µl Solution C5 to the Spin Filter and centrifuge at room temp for 30 secs at 10,000g; discard flow through.
Centrifuge at room temp for 1 min at 10,000g.
Place the Spin Filter in a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.
Add 50 µl Solution C6 to the center of the white filter without touching the filter with the pipette tip.
Centrifuge at room temp for 30 secs at 10,000g (expected recovery ~45 µl).
Store the recovered DNA at -20 °C.

steps.title: Quantify Isolated DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA yield using a Qubit.

steps.title: Purify DNA or PCR Products with AMPure Beads
steps.instruction: Use AMPure beads to purify eDNAs or PCR products.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure beads by inverting multiple times or vortexing.
Add AMPure beads to the DNA sample at a 2:1 ratio by volume. If using PCR products, transfer mixtures to 1.5 ml eppendorf tubes first. Pipette 2-3 times to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Place tubes on a MagnaRack for 5 min until the solution is clear and beads are along the back wall.
Carefully remove the supernatant with a P200 pipette, avoiding the beads.
While tubes remain on the MagnaRack, gently pipette 500 µl of 80% ETOH along the side of the tube (minimum wash volume must be DNA sample + bead volume).
Carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette.
Repeat the 80% ETOH wash once more. After the second wash, use a P20 pipette to remove any remaining ETOH.
Air dry tubes in the rack for 5 min.
Remove tubes from the MagnaRack. Add Elution Buffer (EB): 54 µl for eDNAs or 44 µl for PCR products. Vortex until beads are completely resuspended.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place tubes back on the MagnaRack with caps open and wait 2 min until the solution is clear.
Carefully pipette the supernatant (total EB volume minus 4 µl) into a new tube and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Add Nextera Barcode Tags
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to add Nextera tags using GE Illustra 8-tube strips (25 µl reaction volume).

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix: 5 µl of AMPure-purified or diluted 12S PCR product, 2.5 µl of each index (forward and reverse), and 15 µl H2O.
Run PCR with the following conditions: 95 °C for 5 min; [95 °C for 20s, 55 °C for 20s, 72 °C for 20s] for 10 cycles (use 13 cycles if input was diluted PCR product); 72 °C for 1 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Verify and Purify Tagged Products
steps.instruction: Check the size of the PCR products and purify them.

substeps.instruction: Run 5 µl of each sample on a 2.0% agarose gel (1X TBE) with SyberSafe dye and markers; expected size is ~270 bp.
Purify PCR products using AMPure beads and resuspend in 40 µl Elution Buffer.
Quantify PCR products using Qubit.

steps.title: Prepare and Pool Libraries
steps.instruction: Standardize library concentrations and pool for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 30 nM pooled library in Elution Buffer (for ~270 bp product, 30 nM = 5.4 ng/µl).
Add 108 ng (5.4 ng x 20) of each library to a 1.5 ml eppendorf tube.
Add Elution buffer to reach a final volume of 20 µl per library (e.g., 200 µl for 10 libraries).
Alternatively: Add equal volumes (e.g., 10 µl) of each library to a pool, AMPure purify, measure concentration, and adjust to 15 nM.
